lines.text: You've been holding so tight, waiting for someone to notice.
Let the applause you were chasing finally fall from your hands.
What's growing in you right now was never meant to be seen yet.
Every quiet hour nobody clapped for is still being counted.
You don't need a crowd's verdict to know you're approved.
He already called it good before anyone else looked up.
Rest here. You were never studying for their applause.
You were always studying for an audience of One.

title: Word and Faith Network
subtitle: You already have the only approval that matters.
story: A hand finally loosening its grip on something it was holding too tight, giving way to a seed breaking quiet ground, and settling into the stillness of an anchor at rest — a visual journey from straining for applause to resting in God's approval alone.
